description: US-3: single-focal-point moves from level 2 (fail) to level 0, but the after answer's confidence of 0.5 is below its min_confidence of 0.6, so the after verdict is uncertain and, as a score criterion, its change is uncertain. faint-chart-labels moves from warn at a defect probability of 0.96 to uncertain at 0.5, a drop of 0.15 or more, so its change is better. faint-body-text stays fail but its defect probability rises from 0.75 to 0.95, so it is worse by value. line-length stays the same. The four criteria give one change of each kind, the summary counts them, and skipped is empty because both runs skip the same criterion (FR-35, FR-36, FR-37, FR-39, section 8.2).
